morphology_rules: Blue-to-cyan skin presentation is recurring in the supplied references, with individual/production variation.
Two cranial antennae are the dominant species-readable feature.
Antenna angle, length and curvature may vary by individual.
White-to-silver hair is a strong recurring visual association in the supplied reference set but is not by itself the species identity.
Humanlike facial individuality remains broad beneath species traits.
identity_rules: Antenna geometry belongs to persistent individual morphology.
Injury or regrowth evolves the same antenna identity/history rather than replacing the person.
Skin tone may vary within an approved Andorian range; do not force one exact blue.
forbidden: one antenna shape copied across the population
Aenar treated as cosmetic Andorian variant
